comparar.sinCorridas: You need the current run or a saved one to compare.
comparar.grafico.sinDatos: No samples for this metric yet.
comparar.grafico.bandaCorridas: Band: minimum and maximum of the points that merge several samples.
comparar.grafico.bandaReplicas: Line: mean of the replicates. Band: 10th to 90th percentiles.
comparar.dif.ninguna: Both runs have the same settings.
comparar.rep.origenAyuda: Its scenario is repeated with other seeds, and its live changes at the same cycle. Replicate 1 uses the run's seed.
comparar.rep.sinEscenario: This run did not come from a scenario: it cannot be replicated.
comparar.rep.topeAyuda: Up to 8 at once by default; at most {max} on this computer (cores − 1).
comparar.trabajos.confirmarBorrar: Delete this job and its results?
comparar.trabajos.reanudan: Jobs keep running in the background while the app is open and resume when you open it again.
comparar.aviso.permitido: You will get a notification when a job finishes.
comparar.aviso.denegado: Notifications are blocked: the notice shows up here.
comparar.error.cada: The sampling interval ({detalle}) must be between 1 and the number of cycles.
comparar.error.sin-adn: The DNA of {detalle} was not found.
comparar.rep.avisoAdn: The DNA of {bots} does not match the one saved with the scenario (it changed since): the replicates use the current one.
comparar.rep.reinicio: Replicate {n} restarted the round at cycle {ciclo}: it ends there.
comparar.trabajos.otraPestana: Jobs run in another tab of the app; you can see and manage them from here all the same.
comparar.chip.ayuda: Background jobs (replicates and sweeps): see Analyze › Compare
comparar.error.carga: The engine did not load in the worker: {detalle}
comparar.error.worker: The worker stopped with an error: {detalle}
comparar.error.tiempo: The worker did not answer in time.
comparar.error.desfase: The simulation ended up at a different cycle than expected ({detalle}).
comparar.error.orden-eventos: The run changes are not in cycle order.
comparar.error.sin-duena: The tab running the jobs did not answer. Try again.
comparar.error.detenida: This tab's job queue was closed.
comparar.error.no-reintentable: A tournament round is not retried: ask for another round in Compete.
comparar.bar.origenAyuda: Its scenario runs with the chosen parameter at each value and with several seeds. Live changes repeat at their cycle; those that write that parameter are rewritten with each run’s value (their other effects are kept). The first seed is the run’s.
comparar.bar.lineal: From one value to another in equal steps
comparar.bar.aviso.valor-saturado: {valor}: outside the parameter's type, the limit is used.
comparar.bar.sinResultados: No run of the sweep has finished yet.
comparar.bar.banda: Line: mean final value over the seeds. Band: 10th to 90th percentile.
comparar.bar.bandaSeries: Mean over the seeds of each value; from the lightest color (lowest value) to the darkest.
comparar.bar.curva.otros: {metrica}: mean and band of up to {n} seeds
comparar.error.barrido-derivado: That parameter cannot be swept: it derives from others ({detalle}).
comparar.error.barrido-modo: Unknown way of choosing the values.
comparar.error.barrido-pasos: The number of values goes from 2 to 32.
comparar.error.barrido-valores: Between 2 and 32 distinct values are needed (there are {detalle}).
comparar.error.barrido-unidades: Too many runs ({detalle}): at most 512 between values and seeds.
comparar.bar.valorOrigenCambia: In the run it is {inicio} at the start and {fin} after its live changes.
comparar.bar.arrastra: Sweeping {parametro} also sets {otros} to the same value: the engine writes them together.
comparar.bar.reescritos.uno: The run has {n} live change that writes this parameter: it is rewritten with each run’s value and keeps its other effects.
comparar.bar.reescritos.otros: The run has {n} live changes that write this parameter: they are rewritten with each run’s value and keep their other effects.
comparar.bar.listaEntera: This parameter is an integer: in the list, a value with decimals is an error (it is not rounded).
comparar.bar.linealEntera: This parameter is an integer: each step is rounded to the nearest integer and equal ones are merged.
comparar.bar.aviso.juntados.uno: {n} requested value ended up equal to another (after rounding or clamping) and was merged.
comparar.bar.aviso.juntados.otros: {n} requested values ended up equal to others (after rounding or clamping) and were merged.
comparar.bar.reinicios.uno: {n} run restarted the round before the target cycle: it is left out of the table and the charts.
comparar.bar.reinicios.otros: {n} runs restarted the round before the target cycle: they are left out of the table and the charts.
comparar.bar.error.falta-barrido: Could not generate the report: the sweep’s values, seeds or results are missing.
